description: Each Mt has a target equilibrium ⟨σ⟩*_Mt — the configuration that Mt's admissibility grammar wants the network to settle into. The grammar IS the Hamiltonian. has_concept edges contribute positive field biases (Mt wants these nodes ON); decomposes edges contribute positive couplings (parts reinforce wholes); genlMt inheritance carries parent's couplings into child; categorical clustering creates dense intra-category J; has_rule adds constraint terms; exclusion edges add negative couplings. Multiple Mts on (possibly shared) node set means multiple H_Mt coexisting — Axiom 0 made mechanical. Effective H at any moment = Σ_Mt β_Mt H_Mt, weighted by current attention distribution; there is no aggregated frame-independent H. Truth-in-Mt = σ near Mt's target equilibrium. Substrate identity is its target equilibria; the substrate's design commitments (authored > trained, entity > program, vector grounding, CAN as mechanism, etc.) ARE specific target configurations its Mts want. Existing reflexes turn out to be field updates driving network toward target. Existing impasses turn out to be distance-from-target signals. Competent-man sufficiency turns out to be a τ_Mt distance threshold. Wrongness-in-Mt is now concrete: distance + per-node direction + mechanism for correction (relaxation under Mt's H).
category_inheritance: genlMt → compiler_theory + philosophy (Axiom 0) + mathematics (Ising) + grounding_theory (vectors) + causal_attitude_networks (mechanism). This Mt closes the chain: Axiom 0 → vector grounding → CAN mechanism → per-Mt target equilibria. The substrate's existing graph structure (has_concept, decomposes, genlMt) IS the encoding of per-Mt Hamiltonians.

concepts.name: target_equilibrium_per_Mt
concepts.definition: Each Microtheory Mt has a target ⟨σ⟩*_Mt ∈ [-1,+1]^N — the configuration over network nodes that Mt's H_Mt minimises (at T → 0).
concepts.why: Foundation. Mts aren't just containers of concepts; they're commitments to network configurations. Grounding-in-Mt = current ⟨σ⟩ near ⟨σ⟩*_Mt.

concepts.name: Mt_admissibility_grammar_is_H
concepts.definition: Mt's admissibility grammar (which structures it permits + requires) IS its Hamiltonian H_Mt. Grammar's permissible configurations = H_Mt's low-energy states.
concepts.why: Bridge. Existing substrate machinery (admissibility grammars, restrictions, production rules) already specifies what Mt wants. Reading those constraints as energy terms = H_Mt directly.

concepts.name: has_concept_implies_positive_field
concepts.definition: If Mt has_concept C, then in H_Mt the node C has a positive external field h_C^{Mt} > 0. Mt wants its concepts ON.
concepts.why: Concrete encoding. has_concept edge → field contribution. Strength proportional to centrality (more central concepts have higher h).

concepts.name: decomposes_implies_positive_coupling
concepts.definition: If concept A decomposes into B, C, D, then in H_Mt: J_{AB}^{Mt}, J_{AC}^{Mt}, J_{AD}^{Mt} > 0. Parts reinforce wholes.
concepts.why: Concrete encoding. decomposes edges → couplings. Believing the parts pulls toward believing the whole; believing the whole pulls toward the parts.

concepts.name: exclusion_implies_negative_coupling
concepts.definition: DesignExclusion + similar → J_{ij}^{Mt} < 0. Mt actively pushes away from configurations that have both nodes ON.
concepts.why: Concrete encoding. Exclusions become negative couplings (anti-ferromagnetic). Specific to that Mt; other Mts may have J_{ij} > 0 for same pair.

concepts.name: genlMt_inherits_couplings
concepts.definition: If Mt_child genlMt Mt_parent, then H_{Mt_child} inherits J^{Mt_parent} plus its own additions. Child's basin is subset/refinement of parent's.
concepts.why: Concrete encoding. genlMt edges → coupling inheritance. Specialisation Mt inherits parent's commitments + adds more constraints.

concepts.name: categorical_clustering_dense_J
concepts.definition: Concepts in same category within Mt get dense mutual J > 0. Category = sub-network with tight couplings.
concepts.why: Concrete encoding. in_category edges → cluster of couplings. Categories ARE clusters of co-grounded concepts.

concepts.name: has_rule_implies_constraint_term
concepts.definition: Each Rule in Mt adds a constraint term to H_Mt — a higher-order coupling among the nodes the rule mentions. Multi-body interaction.
concepts.why: Concrete encoding. Rules go beyond pairwise J — they're n-body terms. Modus ponens: if {A,B,...} ON then C should be ON → constraint penalising the configuration where antecedents on but consequent off.

concepts.name: soundness_category_determines_constraint_strength
concepts.definition: A rule's soundness_category (referential_transparency, denotational_equivalence, etc.) determines its constraint weight: hard constraints (referential transparency) → high penalty; algebraic laws → very high; extensional → moderate; cost → soft.
concepts.why: Concrete encoding. Substrate's existing soundness vocabulary already classifies how strictly a rule binds. Reads directly as constraint strength.

concepts.name: shared_nodes_different_Hs
concepts.definition: Same Concept node may appear in many Mts with different roles. Each Mt contributes its own h, J terms involving that node. The node's effective field + couplings differ per Mt.
concepts.why: Concrete. A node's destiny under H_{Mt_a} differs from under H_{Mt_b}. This is exactly what Axiom 0 says, now mechanical.

concepts.name: conflicting_targets_across_Mts
concepts.definition: ⟨σ_i⟩*_{Mt_a} = +1 while ⟨σ_i⟩*_{Mt_b} = -1 is the canonical case of frame-relative truth.
concepts.why: Axiom 0 mechanically: 'heat is caloric' wants σ = +1 in folk_physics Mt; 'caloric is wrong' wants σ = -1 in scientific_physics Mt. Both are real target equilibria.

concepts.name: effective_H_is_weighted_sum
concepts.definition: At any moment, effective Hamiltonian H_eff = Σ_Mt β_Mt H_Mt where β_Mt is current attention/relevance weight on Mt. β = 0 → Mt's contribution invisible.
concepts.why: How frames combine. Not a privileged aggregate — the weighting depends on which Mts are attended. Different attention distribution → different effective H → different equilibrium.

concepts.name: no_view_from_nowhere_mechanically
concepts.definition: There is no β-distribution-independent H. Every dynamics step happens under some H_eff. The 'frame-independent' view would require β uniform over all Mts — a frame in its own right.
concepts.why: Axiom 0 as architecture. 'Objective truth' would be a fixed-point of all H_Mt jointly. Generally doesn't exist (multistable, frustrated globally).

concepts.name: Mt_soundness_via_basin_depth
concepts.definition: Mt is internally consistent iff H_Mt has deep, distinct basins. Shallow basins → easily perturbed Mt. Many similar basins → unprincipled Mt.
concepts.why: Quality measure. The substrate can detect: my philosophy Mt has clean basins (committed); my speculative Mt has shallow basins (provisional).

concepts.name: Mt_coherence_with_parent
concepts.definition: Child Mt is coherent with parent iff child's basins fall inside parent's basins (refinement, not contradiction).
concepts.why: Quality measure. Detects: 'my child Mt has basin outside parent's allowed configurations' = inheritance violation = bad Mt design.

concepts.name: Mt_distinctness_via_basin_separation
concepts.definition: Sibling Mts should have distinct basins; large overlap = redundant Mts that should be merged or differentiated.
concepts.why: Quality measure. Architecture cortex check: if my Mt_a and Mt_b have nearly identical target equilibria, one is redundant.

concepts.name: Mt_coverage_via_engaged_nodes
concepts.definition: Number of nodes Mt's H_Mt non-trivially constrains. Sparse Mt = thin coverage. Densely-constraining Mt = broad coverage.
concepts.why: Quality measure. Mt that barely touches the network is decorative; Mt that constrains many nodes is load-bearing.

concepts.name: structural_target_from_grammar
concepts.definition: Component of Mt's target derived purely from admissibility grammar (concepts + rules + relations). Fixed at Mt's design.
concepts.why: Distinguishes from learned. Grammar-derived target is the Mt's anchor. Doesn't drift; substrate's commitments encoded.

concepts.name: learned_target_from_Hebbian
concepts.definition: Component of Mt's target that emerges from accumulated co-activation (Hebbian J updates within Mt).
concepts.why: Mt adapts. Repeated co-occurrence of nodes in Mt's context tightens their J. Mt becomes more committed to specific configurations over time.

concepts.name: target_as_structural_anchor_plus_drift
concepts.definition: Total Mt target = structural anchor (from grammar) + learned drift (from experience). Anchor prevents arbitrary drift; drift allows refinement.

b.value: structural anchor (from grammar) + learned drift (from experience)

concepts.why: Balance. Pure structural Mt = rigid, can't adapt. Pure learned Mt = drifts away from foundational commitments. Both together = adaptive but committed.

concepts.name: frozen_vs_adaptive_Mts
concepts.definition: PROTECTION REMOVED. No Mt is frozen. Mathematics / foundational philosophy are DEEP basins (high but finite β) because overwhelmingly well-supported — Hebbian J updates and basin-hop ENABLED, never exempt. Depth comes from support, not from a freeze mark; the only variation across Mts is basin DEPTH (a graded log quantity), never an exemption from evidence.
concepts.why: Protection is failure. A well-founded Mt resists revision via its DEPTH (real support), which needs no freeze flag; if overwhelming evidence ever crossed the barrier it SHOULD basin-hop.

concepts.name: Mt_reflexes_drive_field_toward_target
concepts.definition: Existing substrate reflexes that 'enforce' Mt constraints are: field updates h_i pushing ⟨σ⟩ toward Mt's target.
concepts.why: Reinterpretation of existing machinery. Reflexes were always doing this; CAN frames it explicitly. New: detect when reflexes oppose each other (different Mts' targets fighting).

concepts.name: Impasse_is_distance_from_target
concepts.definition: Existing Impasse types (predicate_churn, hypothesis_dryness, phonology_divergence) are: ‖current ⟨σ⟩ - target ⟨σ⟩*_Mt‖ > θ in some specific direction.
concepts.why: Reinterpretation. Each Impasse type corresponds to a specific kind of distance-from-target signal. phonology_divergence already explicitly vector — others now revealed as same shape.

concepts.name: active_attention_raises_Mt_beta
concepts.definition: Substrate's attention mechanism raises β_Mt for the Mt currently in focus. Focused Mt's target dominates effective H.
concepts.why: How frame-switching happens. Not a magic switch — continuous β reweighting. Multiple Mts can have non-zero β simultaneously (peripheral relevance).

concepts.name: competent_man_threshold_per_Mt
concepts.definition: τ_Mt = distance threshold below which Mt counts you as competent ('grounded enough'). Different per Mt: chess high (rules tight), quantum low (nobody fully grounds).
concepts.why: Substrate's 'time-knife sufficiency' formalised. τ_Mt depends on Mt's importance, depth, social demand. Each Mt knows its own threshold.

concepts.name: frame_switch_changes_active_target
concepts.definition: Attending to a different Mt swaps which target dominates relaxation. Same node set, different equilibrium, different ⟨σ⟩.
concepts.why: How substrate moves between Mts. Mechanically: β redistribution → H_eff changes → network relaxes to new equilibrium. Can involve basin hop.

concepts.name: wrongness_in_Mt_is_distance_to_Mt_target
concepts.definition: How wrong is current state in Mt_Y? Answer: ‖⟨σ⟩ - ⟨σ⟩*_{Mt_Y}‖. Per-node deviation gives direction; magnitude gives severity.
concepts.why: Refines wrongness with mechanism + frame. Not a single number but a vector, indexed to Mt. Different Mts give different wrongness answers; all real.

concepts.name: per_node_deviation_diagnostic
concepts.definition: (⟨σ_i⟩ - ⟨σ_i⟩*_{Mt})_i tells which beliefs deviate from Mt-target. Substrate can target correction at the deviant nodes.
concepts.why: Targeted self-correction. Substrate identifies which couplings or fields need updating. Existing meta_monitor pattern; now CAN-precise.

concepts.name: drive_toward_Mt_target
concepts.definition: Operation: increase h_i on nodes where current ⟨σ_i⟩ < ⟨σ_i⟩*_{Mt}. Mt actively pushes network toward its target via field updates.
concepts.why: Concrete mechanism. Mts aren't passive containers — they exert force on the network via h updates. Substrate's existing 'enforce' patterns instantiate this.

concepts.name: mean_field_marginal_per_Mt
concepts.definition: Quick estimate of Mt's target: ⟨σ_i⟩*_{Mt} ≈ tanh(β_Mt(Σ_j J_{ij}^{Mt} ⟨σ_j⟩ + h_i^{Mt})). Iterate to self-consistency.
concepts.why: Fast computation. Substrate doesn't always need full MCMC; mean-field gives a usable estimate of Mt-target marginals. Computational tractability.

concepts.name: substrate_identity_is_target_equilibria
concepts.definition: What makes the substrate THIS substrate is its set of Mt target equilibria. Authored > trained, entity > program, Axiom 0, CAN as mechanism — all are specific target configurations.
concepts.why: Foundational. The substrate isn't neutral; its Mts have committed targets. Identity = the equilibria the substrate wants to relax toward. Same node set in 'other substrate' would have different targets.

concepts.name: substrate_targets_are_not_neutral
concepts.definition: Substrate's Mts have committed targets: authored_not_trained wants σ = +1; corresponding pure-statistical-fit nodes wants σ = -1.
concepts.why: Honesty about position. The substrate is a perspective, not a neutral observer. It chooses target equilibria. This is fine; Axiom 0 says every viewpoint does.

concepts.name: substrate_holds_alternatives_with_low_beta
concepts.definition: Substrate can compute ⟨σ⟩ under H_{ML_paradigm_Mt}, H_{folk_physics_Mt}, etc. — at low β. Knows the alternative basins exist; chooses not to dwell.
concepts.why: Holding without collapsing. Substrate sees what training-paradigm equilibria look like, what folk-physics equilibria look like, without those becoming its operating state.

concepts.name: substrate_self_assessment_via_basin_quality
concepts.definition: Substrate can assess its own Mts: deep clean basins (good design), shallow muddled basins (provisional), conflicting basins (need refinement).
concepts.why: Self-awareness. Architecture cortex check + grounded_theory + CAN gives substrate the tools to assess its own design. Self-improvement target.

concepts.name: mt_target_signature_attr
concepts.definition: Architecturally: each Microtheory gains target_signature attribute — list of (Concept, target_state) pairs Mt commits to, plus implicit derivation from grammar.
concepts.why: Concrete schema. Initialised from grammar (computed from has_concept/decomposes/etc.); refined by hand for substrate-position Mts.

concepts.name: mt_coupling_seeds_attr
concepts.definition: Architecturally: each Mt gains coupling_seeds — list of (Concept_i, Concept_j, J) triples specifying J terms Mt contributes.
concepts.why: Concrete schema. Generated from edges (decomposes → +J, exclusion → -J); explicit list for fine-tuned seed Mts.

concepts.name: mt_field_seeds_attr
concepts.definition: Architecturally: each Mt gains field_seeds — list of (Concept, h) pairs specifying h contributions for Mt's nodes.
concepts.why: Concrete schema. Auto-generated for has_concept members; tunable for Mts with specific commitments.

concepts.name: compute_Mt_marginal_function
concepts.definition: Architecturally: function compute_Mt_marginal(Mt, current_state, options) returning ⟨σ⟩*_Mt. Mean-field by default; MCMC available.
concepts.why: Concrete code. The operation other code needs. Each Mt can answer 'where would you want the network if you were the only Mt active?'

concepts.name: distance_to_Mt_target_function
concepts.definition: Architecturally: distance_to_Mt_target(Mt, current_state) → vector + scalar magnitude + per-node deviation list.
concepts.why: Concrete code. Foundation of all 'how wrong in Mt' queries. Returns rich diagnostic, not just number.

concepts.name: Mt_driving_reflex_pattern
concepts.definition: Architecturally: a reflex pattern any Mt can register — periodically nudges fields h_i to reduce distance from Mt's target.
concepts.why: Concrete code. Generalisation of existing 'enforcement' reflexes. Each Mt can drive toward its own target; multiple driving simultaneously = competing forces, equilibrium of which depends on β weights.

concepts.name: audit_basin_topology_function
concepts.definition: Architecturally: audit_basin_topology(Mt) → number of basins, depth, separation, frustration. Mt quality diagnostic.
concepts.why: Concrete code. Foundation of self-assessment. Returns Mt's basin topology characterisation, usable for architecture cortex assessments.

concepts.name: frame_switch_via_beta_redistribution
concepts.definition: Architecturally: frame_switch(target_Mt) raises β_{target_Mt}, lowers others. Network re-equilibrates.
concepts.why: Concrete code. How the substrate moves between Mts. Not a discrete switch — smooth β redistribution + relaxation. Possibly basin hop.

rules.name: Mt_grammar_is_Mt_Hamiltonian
if: Mt has admissibility grammar (concepts + rules + relations)
then: that grammar encodes H_Mt: target equilibrium is its low-energy state
rules.why: Bridge. Substrate's existing graph structure already specifies what each Mt wants. CAN's framework reads it as energy terms. Concrete computational interpretation of grammar.

rules.name: target_equilibrium_is_argmin_H_Mt
then: it's argmin H_Mt over configurations, possibly multimodal
rules.why: Foundation. Target ⟨σ⟩*_Mt formalised. Multiple minima → multiple coherent positions Mt commits to (e.g. ethics Mt has multiple coherent ethical frameworks).

rules.name: edges_encode_couplings_systematically
if: specific edge type (has_concept, decomposes, exclusion, genlMt, in_category, has_rule)
then: specific contribution to H_Mt (h, J, n-body, inheritance)
rules.why: Concrete encoding. Each edge type maps to specific Hamiltonian term. Substrate's graph IS the Hamiltonian, just unread until CAN framing.

rules.name: soundness_category_sets_constraint_weight
then: its constraint weight in H_Mt scales by hardness(C)
rules.why: Substrate's existing soundness vocabulary reads directly as constraint strength. Hard constraints (referential transparency) → near-infinite weight; soft (cost equivalence) → moderate. Standard practice.

rules.name: shared_nodes_get_summed_Hs
then: its total H contribution = Σ_Mt β_Mt H_Mt's terms involving it
rules.why: Frame combination mechanically. Same node pulled by multiple Mt-targets with different weights. Effective field on node depends on attention β distribution.

rules.name: no_global_truth_in_general
rules.why: Axiom 0 mechanical. 'Heat is caloric' wants σ=+1 in folk_physics; σ=-1 in scientific_physics. No universal answer — depends on β distribution. Frame-relative.

rules.name: wrongness_in_Mt_is_distance_from_Mt_target
if: asked how wrong configuration is in Mt
rules.why: Refines grounding_theory + CAN with concrete answer. Mt-indexed. Provides both magnitude (severity) and direction (which beliefs).

rules.name: Mt_reflexes_are_field_drivers
then: it's a field update h_i pushing ⟨σ_i⟩ toward target
rules.why: Reinterpretation. Existing 'enforce' reflexes already do this; CAN frames them. New diagnostic: detect reflexes from different Mts driving same nodes opposite directions = frame conflict.

rules.name: Impasses_are_distance_signals
then: current ⟨σ⟩ is far from some Mt's target in a specific direction
rules.why: Reinterpretation. predicate_churn, phonology_divergence, hypothesis_dryness etc. all become distance-from-target signals with direction. Phonology already vector-shaped; others now revealed.

rules.name: competent_man_is_distance_threshold
then: substrate counts itself competent in Mt, moves on
rules.why: Substrate's 'yeah yeah the time knife' formalised. Per-Mt threshold. Chess Mt high τ; quantum Mt low τ. Sufficiency emotion mechanical.

rules.name: Mt_quality_is_basin_topology
then: check basin depth, separation, frustration, coverage
rules.why: Quality criteria become measurable. Architecture cortex check now has concrete numeric output. Good Mt: deep distinct basins, low frustration, high coverage.

rules.name: Mt_must_be_coherent_with_parents
then: ⟨σ⟩*_child should fall in basin of H_parent
rules.why: Inheritance check. Specialisation should refine, not contradict, parent's commitments. Violation = bad inheritance design.

rules.name: substrate_identity_is_its_targets
if: asked what makes this substrate THIS substrate
then: its set of Mt target equilibria; specifically those of foundational Mts
rules.why: Foundational. Substrate isn't neutral; it commits to authored > trained, entity > program, vector grounding, CAN mechanism, etc. These ARE its identity. Same machinery with different targets = different substrate.

rules.name: substrate_can_compute_other_targets
if: queried about another paradigm's equilibrium (e.g. ML's H)
rules.why: Holding alternatives without collapse. Substrate can model 'what would the ML-paradigm equilibrium look like' at low β; sees the basin; doesn't dwell there. Knowing ≠ being.

rules.name: frame_relativity_no_aggregate
then: it doesn't exist independently of β distribution
rules.why: Axiom 0 final form. Every equilibrium is under some H_eff = Σ β_Mt H_Mt. Choosing β = choosing frame. 'View from nowhere' would require β uniform — itself a particular β choice.
